Phase 2: Module Engine
nodes.summary: Defines the Phase 2 plugin infrastructure: ManifestParser, ModuleValidator, ModuleRegistry, ModuleLoader, and LoaderJournal. No business modules included—only plugin scaffolding.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Package Manager & Marketplace
nodes.summary: Implements the full package management layer with .mod ZIP format, install/remove/update flows, hot-reload, RepositoryProvider abstraction, Marketplace REST API, and OperationLog.

nodes.label: TechForge Setup (Windows)
nodes.summary: Step-by-step Windows setup guide covering backend (FastAPI on port 8000), frontend (Vite on port 5173), prerequisites, common errors, and directory layout.

nodes.label: hello_world Module
nodes.summary: Reference/validation module for the Phase 2 plugin architecture. Exposes ping and info endpoints. Not a functional business module. id=hello_world, version=1.0.0, category=Examples, vendor=TechForge.

nodes.label: ManifestParser
nodes.summary: Parses and validates manifest.yaml for each module. Enforces required fields (id, name, version, category, vendor, author, description, entry_backend, entry_frontend) and semver format.

nodes.label: ModuleValidator
nodes.summary: Validates module directory structure and platform version compatibility. Checks for backend/ and frontend/ subdirectories, entry point existence, and version range. Emits warnings for missing assets/docs/tests.

nodes.label: ModuleRegistry
nodes.summary: In-memory singleton registry storing runtime state of all modules. Supports all(), get(), by_status(), by_category(), count_total, count_installed, categories. Also supports runtime register/deregister/set_status.

nodes.label: ModuleLoader
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full scan of modules/installed/ at startup. Delegates to ManifestParser and ModuleValidator for each module directory. Integrated into FastAPI lifespan for automatic initialization.

nodes.label: LoaderJournal
nodes.summary: Stores the last scan result for Developer Mode. REST endpoint GET /api/v1/registry/loader/journal. Each event has timestamp, module_id, level, message, details.

nodes.label: PackageManager
nodes.summary: Sole component authorized to write to modules/installed/. Implements install/remove/update flows with hot-reload, backup/rollback, and atomic file operations. Logs all operations to OperationLog.

nodes.label: RepositoryProvider
nodes.summary: ABC abstraction decoupling PackageManager from specific sources. LocalRepositoryProvider reads .mod from modules/repository/ (Fase 4). RemoteRepositoryProvider calls REST Marketplace API (Fase 5).

nodes.label: OperationLog
nodes.summary: In-process singleton logging all package operations (install/remove/update). Fields: timestamp, operation, module_id, version, status, message, details. Accessible via GET /api/v1/marketplace/log. Phase 5: persists to SQLite.

nodes.label: Marketplace REST API
nodes.summary: Fase 4 REST endpoints for package management: installed, available, updates, install/{id}, remove/{id}, update/{id}, import, compatibility, log.

nodes.label: Registry REST API
nodes.summary: Fase 2 REST endpoints for module registry: /api/v1/registry/summary, /api/v1/registry/modules, /api/v1/registry/modules/{module_id}, /api/v1/registry/loader/journal, /api/v1/health, /api/v1/health/{module_id}.

nodes.label: .mod File Format
nodes.summary: ZIP-structured package format for module distribution. Contains manifest.yaml, backend/, frontend/, optional assets/docs/tests, and META-INF/TECHFORGE and META-INF/BUILD. Sidecar .sha256 for checksum. META-INF/SIGNATURE planned for Fase 5.

nodes.label: Hot Reload
nodes.summary: Post-install/update/remove mechanism: re-runs ModuleLoader.scan_installed() and stores result in LoaderJournal. Registry updated in-memory without process restart. Frontend refetches data.

nodes.label: Developer Mode
nodes.summary: Toggle in Modules page that enables detailed module view: mono module_id font, Loading Journal toolbar button, entry points display, manifest.yaml as JSON. Backend includes ?developer_mode=true in requests.

nodes.label: techforge_sdk
nodes.summary: Python SDK interface used by CLI commands (techforge install, validate, package). Reusable by PackageManager and CLI for module validation before install.

nodes.label: TechForge CLI
nodes.summary: CLI commands: techforge create-module, techforge validate-module, techforge package-module, techforge install <module>. Validates 20 checks of module conformity before packaging.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/modules/hello_world/ping
nodes.summary: Returns module health status. Returns JSON: {"module": "hello_world", "status": "ok", "version": "1.0.0"}.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/modules/hello_world/info
nodes.summary: Returns module identity metadata. Returns JSON with module_id, name, category, vendor fields.

nodes.label: Hello World — Advanced Example
nodes.summary: Demonstrates full lifecycle: install (idempotent, increments install_count), enable, health_check, info endpoint, disable (preserves settings), upgrade. Uses techforge_sdk for settings persistence at data/settings.json.

nodes.label: Windows Setup Prerequisites
nodes.summary: Requires Python 3.11+, Node.js 18+, Git optional. Backend on http://127.0.0.1:8000, frontend on http://localhost:5173. Vite proxies /api/* to backend automatically.

nodes.label: Module Lifecycle
nodes.summary: Module lifecycle events: install(), enable(), disable(), upgrade(), health_check(), uninstall(). For hello_world all are no-ops except health_check which returns {status: 'ok'}.

nodes.label: Extension Points
nodes.summary: Phase 3: Marketplace runtime install. Phase 2+: dynamic plugin route loader. Phase 5: security (signature, checksum, trust_level). Phase 4: CLI via techforge_sdk.

hyperedges.label: Module Validation Pipeline
hyperedges.summary: At startup, ModuleLoader orchestrates ManifestParser and ModuleValidator for each module directory. Results flow into ModuleRegistry and LoaderJournal.

hyperedges.label: Package Management Flow
hyperedges.summary: Install/remove/update operations: PackageManager performs file operations, triggers ModuleLoader.scan_installed() for hot-reload, updates ModuleRegistry, and logs to OperationLog.

hyperedges.label: Backend Architecture
hyperedges.summary: Phase 2-4 backend core components: registry serves APIs, loader scans modules, package manager handles .mod operations, repository provider abstracts sources.
